data.one_liner: Monitors file system changes and notifies when files are added, removed, or modified.
data.what_it_does: A file system watcher that monitors the contents of directories. It sends notifications when files have been added, removed, or modified across multiple platforms.
use_when: You need to monitor directory contents for additions, deletions, or modifications.
Building developer tools or local file-processing utilities that react to file changes.
avoid_when: You only need a one-time file picker interface instead of background observation.
strengths: Cross-platform support for Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Handles OS-specific quirks such as Windows buffer exhaustion and symlink loops.
weaknesses: May hit system watcher limits on Linux depending on configuration.
Polling watchers may have limitations with low-resolution timestamps.
data.setup_notes: No special setup or permissions documented.
